data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 822.7m. The syndicate recorded a prior-year release (favourable development) of GBP 85.8m in 2014, driven by favourable development and recalibration of IBNR across multiple classes. The release was attributed across a range of classes (notably marine/upstream energy, war/political violence/political risk, commercial property, downstream energy & power, financial lines, airlines and treaty reinsurance). No gross prior-year movement figure was provided in the movement note (the report explicitly states the movement as a net release), so the reported GBP 85.8m is net of reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: The movement in prior year's provision note explicitly states a release of GBP 85.8m but describes this as a reassessment of the net provision (net of reinsurance). No gross prior-year movement (insurance liabilities / gross) figure is provided in the report. Per extraction rules, the disclosed prior-year movement has been recorded as net (negative = release) and flagged. LOB mappings for the movement allocations are approximate (the movement note presents net figures by the syndicate's class names). No gross claims development triangle was found in the report to derive a gross PYD.
